verdicts.notes: Living and dining zones are clearly separated yet connected; sofa faces the TV wall, circulation to sliding doors and hallway remains clear, and no furniture intersects openings or each other.

Combined living+dining layout is present, sliding doors to the garden are preserved, and the TV wall is the clear focal point of the living zone; style and palette are contemporary with warm neutrals plus charcoal/black accents, consistent with the brief.

Only visible change from the previous concept is the coffee table set (black two-piece swapped for a single round stone-look table); architecture, palette, layout, and other key furniture remain unchanged, with no drift.

Sofa, coffee table, dining set, and rugs all scale plausibly within a roughly 5.8m x 7m room; door heights and ceiling height relate correctly to furniture, with no oversized or miniaturized anchor pieces.

Across the hero and two additional views, the combined living/dining zoning, TV wall focal, and sliding doors are all visible; close-up view reinforces furniture/texture but does not omit any key element across the set.

Palette is a deliberate warm-neutral register—ivory floors and walls, beige rugs, taupe/brown dining chairs, grey sofa, and black/charcoal metal accents—clearly traceable to the specified color notes rather than generic beige defaulting.
Bed, nightstands, and bench are all grounded and aligned with the window focal wall; side clearances and doorway remain unobstructed, and circulation along both sides of the bed is plausible.

Contemporary style is evident in the clean-lined upholstered bed, simple drum tables, and minimal art; the palette follows ivory/cream, champagne, taupe, blush throw, warm gold sconces, and dark walnut/taupe tables; blackout curtains are visibly installed as full-height, heavy drapery across the window wall, and there are no visible elements contradicting the brief.

Architecture, layout, palette, and key furniture are unchanged; the only visible revision is swapping table lamps in the previous concept for wall sconces in the current one, which fits a targeted lighting update without broader drift.

Given a 4.8 m wall and 4.1 m depth, the king bed, bench, and nightstands occupy realistic widths and heights; ceiling height aligns with the fan and curtain proportions, with no dollhouse- or oversized-scale pieces.

Across the hero plus two additional views, the bed-wall focal, window and blackout drapery, nightstands, lighting, and artwork are all clearly shown; the close-up view highlights texture and materials on the key elements.

The scheme is a deliberate warm, restful tonal register using creams, taupes, blush, and warm gold accents that directly reflects the brief’s color notes rather than a generic beige default; the blush throw and gold sconces provide the grounded accent within the neutral field.
